Expected_Relationship: P602 ON should produce a different FIT601 reading than P602 OFF (direction determined empirically, not assumed).
Rationale: P602 is Stage 6's only varying actuator and FIT601 is Stage 6's only sensor -- this is the SOLE structurally available candidate in Stage 6, not a rule transplanted from another stage because it 'worked there'. A pump mechanically gating its own downstream flow meter is the same class of relationship independently validated in Stages 1 (S1-R1), 2 (S2-R1), 3 (S3-R1), 4 (S4-R2), and 5 (S5-R1), but here it is being tested, not assumed, on Stage 6's own data.
Confidence: high a priori for the relationship CATEGORY (direct mechanical gating is about as certain a hydraulic relationship as exists), but P602's own operational role is sparse (150 TRAIN transitions, 0.85% ON-time) -- confidence in the SPECIFIC empirical outcome is reserved for Part 3.
